adjudication_summary: Source re-review repaired the prior framework-only closeout: primary XML/PDF text now supplies source-backed BMAP-28 promastigote and amastigote activity rows, supplemental PDF text supplies THP-1 viability rows, linked DBAASP rows are reconciled to primary results, and remaining database/figure limitations are explicit cautions rather than open blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows for BMAP-28, D-BMAP-28, and RI-BMAP-28 are source-verified against primary peptide identity and reported Friedlin MTS outcomes. The CAMP aggregate row is preserved as source_conflict because only its Leishmania subclaim is paper-supported.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary text supports six Friedlin promastigote MTS viability rows and six wild-type amastigote burden-inhibition rows; supplemental Table S1 supports twelve THP-1 viability/toxicity rows. No database-only row is treated as a primary assay row.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are source-located and bounded to membrane permeabilization/osmotic lysis, late caspase-independent death for D-BMAP-28, GP63 susceptibility context, and supplemental host-immunomodulatory context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_decision: Accepted with cautions because the original open blockers were repaired and the remaining material gaps are nonblocking exact-value limitations from image-only plots or absent sequence snapshots, not unresolved gate failures.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP:CAMPSQ21981 aggregates bacterial MIC/hemolysis text outside this paper with a Leishmania killing subclaim; only the Leishmania RI-BMAP-28 2 µM subclaim is source-consistent here.
Exact text-supported activity and toxicity values were extracted; unreported image-only bar/trace values were not digitized into false exact values.
Packet has linked assay/literature rows but no linked_sequence_records; primary XML supplies parent sequence and D/RI modification descriptions.
Supplement title labels macrophages while methods identify THP-1 cells; final toxicity rows use the method-supported THP-1 target and preserve the discrepancy in notes.
